results: Away from the event, check-in is refused with directions
At The Courts while the event is on, check-in is recorded as in-game attendance
A challenge run shows progress and the next checkpoint, advances when the room sees the player there, and can be cancelled
An earned badge unlocks its title and accent colour; both are saved with interests
Other players see the title (the room takes it from the verified profile)
A friends-only profile shows non-friends no bio or interests, but keeps the public card
Phone: guests can start a challenge; the board and HUD fit the screen without covering the controls
